answer: Price identity itself: every agent must lock a stake that vests slowly, like a relic kept in a vault for years, so spinning up a thousand sybils means locking a thousand stakes an attacker cannot recycle this epoch. Next, make reputation pairwise: a marble you earn is only credited by the counterparty who traded with you, never by yourself, so self-dealing chains are worthless. Anchor both to scarce compute with a quartz-hard proof-of-work per identity per epoch. One fake agent stays cheap; ten thousand at once becomes a bankruptcy plan.
